# The spine, disassembled

*Generated by `tools/disassemble_spine.py`. Every artifact a spine sequence places was instantiated in Godot (headless, two frames to build) and its elements read off the tree it made: meshes by shape, size and colour, colliders, bodies, joints, lights, labels, particles, multimeshes, and whether a script ticks. Identical meshes fold into `(shape) * n`. The category is read from the elements, not the name. Palle, 25 Oct 2026: "can we disassemble to extract the element and categorize every artifact in the spine?"*

**1341 artifacts across the 25 sequences, 1341 run.** By what they are made of: array 642, void-built 249, assemblage 145, field 131, document 84, solid 40, empty 31, line 16, point 2, hang 1; 752 of them tick (an engine). *void-built* is a token with no registry scene — a work The Void builds itself from rooms.json (the void_* works, kits, props), which this probe cannot instantiate alone; *empty* built nothing headless (it waits for a map, a hand or a player); *hang* never yielded a frame and was killed by the watchdog. In the shape counts, "(multimesh)" numbers are instances, not nodes — a lattice of 600,000 spheres is one node.
